identity.isin_confidence_note: IMPORTANT ENTITY TRAP: there are TWO distinct 'Meghmani Organics' ISINs in circulation. The pre-2021 company (ISIN INE974H01013, old BSE code 532865) was the ORIGINAL Meghmani Organics Ltd. Under a 2021 NCLT-sanctioned Composite Scheme of Arrangement, that original company amalgamated into Meghmani Finechem Limited, with 'Meghmani Organochem Limited' as the resulting/demerged entity; Meghmani Organochem was subsequently renamed Meghmani Organics Limited and is the company that trades TODAY as NSE:MOL / BSE:543331, ISIN INE0CT101020, CIN L24299GJ2019PLC110321 (CIN year 2019 confirms it is the newer corporate shell). screener.in in fact lists the old entity separately under ticker MEGH with the label '(Merged)'. This pack is entirely about the CURRENT trading entity (MOL / 543331 / INE0CT101020) — confirmed via upstox.com, marketscreener.com, and cross-referenced against the company's own filing letterhead (Scrip Code 543331, Symbol MOL).
sources: https://meghmani.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/unaudited-financial-results-31-03-2026.pdf (primary source, board outcome letter + audited results, dated 14-May-2026)

valuation.eps_ttm_basis: Consolidated (owners' share), FY2026 full year (Apr-2025 to Mar-2026) diluted EPS = Rs 1.13, taken directly from the company's audited consolidated financial results filed with BSE/NSE on 14-May-2026 (Statement row XVI). valuation.book_value_standalone_note: Standalone (parent-only, excludes subsidiaries) book value is materially higher at ~Rs 69.14/share (Total Standalone Equity Rs 1,758.32 Cr / 25.43 Cr shares), because the loss-making subsidiaries (Meghmani Crop Nutrition, Kilburn Chemicals) drag down consolidated equity. All headline figures in this pack use CONSOLIDATED unless stated otherwise, matching screener.in/groww.in convention.
valuation.roe_note: screener.in (consolidated): 1.88%. groww.in (consolidated): 1.86%. Independently recomputed: consolidated FY26 net profit attributable to owners (Rs 28.74 Cr) / consolidated closing equity (Rs 1,544.78 Cr) = 1.86% — matches. This is a very low ROE because consolidated FY26 profit is thin (subsidiaries lost money); the STANDALONE (parent-only) ROE is far higher at ~7.1-7.4% (standalone net profit Rs 125.26 Cr / standalone equity ~Rs 1,695-1,758 Cr), underscoring that group structure materially depresses reported group profitability versus the parent's actual operating performance.

A late-June-2026-dated aggregator snippet (business-standard-style content) cited a 1-year decline of -42.18%. No 52-week price-change percentage is asserted as a single fact in this pack; treat the true value as being in the wide band of roughly -42% to -50% as of late June/early July 2026, pending a direct historical-price lookup.

dividends.declared_unpaid_note: One low-quality aggregator source (freepressjournal.in, echoed by univest.in) claimed the board 'recommended a dividend of Rs 1.20 per equity share' alongside the Q4 FY26 results on 14-May-2026. This claim is EXPLICITLY NOT CORROBORATED: (a) trendlyne.com's dedicated corporate-actions history for MOL/543331 shows no dividend for 2025 or 2026 at all; (b) the company's own primary board-outcome letter to BSE/NSE dated 14-May-2026 (fetched directly as a PDF from meghmani.com) makes NO mention of any dividend recommendation anywhere in its text; (c) the same freepressjournal/univest articles also stated a Q4 FY26 consolidated net profit of Rs 30.8 Cr on Rs 481.6 Cr revenue, which directly CONTRADICTS the audited filing's Rs 8.03 Cr net profit on Rs 474.34 Cr revenue (confirmed independently via screener.in AND via line-by-line reconstruction of the primary PDF's consolidated P&L). Given this source has at least one other independently-falsifiable factual error in the same article, the Rs 1.20/share dividend claim is treated as UNRELIABLE and is NOT included as a declared-unpaid dividend in this pack.

Q4 FY26 (Mar-2026), reported 14-May-2026, correctly remains the latest reported quarter.

corporate_structure_note.note: Meghmani Organics Limited's board approved a Scheme of Amalgamation on 4-Apr-2026 to merge two of its own wholly-owned subsidiaries — Kilburn Chemicals Limited and Meghmani Crop Nutrition Limited — into the parent, with an appointed date of 1-Jan-2026. Shareholders approved this via postal ballot/NCLT-convened meetings in June 2026 (99.99% approval reported). As of the FY26 audited results (14-May-2026), the Scheme had NOT yet become effective (pending NCLT sanction), so no accounting effect of the merger is reflected in the FY26 numbers in this pack. This is a live corporate-action item worth tracking for subsequent quarters, as it will simplify/change the standalone-vs-consolidated split reported here once effective.

notes: ENTITY TRAP (high-severity): 'Meghmani Organics Ltd' has TWO ISINs in the wild. The pre-2021 entity (ISIN INE974H01013, old BSE 532865) amalgamated/demerged in 2021; the surviving/renamed entity trading TODAY is NSE:MOL / BSE:543331 / ISIN INE0CT101020 / CIN L24299GJ2019PLC110321. screener.in itself lists the old entity separately as ticker 'MEGH' labelled '(Merged)'. An initial WebFetch of screener.in/company/MEGH/ returned entirely STALE data (a Dec-2020-vintage quarterly result, price Rs 138, mcap Rs 3,516 Cr) — that page/ticker was the wrong, defunct entity and was discarded in favor of screener.in/company/MOL/, which returned current (09-Jul-2026) data.

A PRIMARY SOURCE (the company's own audited Q4/FY26 results PDF, filed with BSE/NSE on 14-May-2026 and fetched directly from meghmani.com) was used to cross-verify screener.in's quarterly figures line-by-line. They match to the rupee on both revenue and net profit for Q4 FY26 and Q4 FY25 (consolidated), which is a strong confidence signal for the quarterly-results section of this pack.

Two low-quality secondary aggregators (freepressjournal.in and univest.in) independently reported Q4 FY26 consolidated figures of Rs 481.6 Cr revenue / Rs 30.8 Cr net profit (+66.5% YoY) and a claimed Rs 1.20/share dividend recommendation. ALL of these figures directly contradict the audited primary-source filing (Rs 474.34 Cr revenue / Rs 8.03 Cr net profit) and are NOT corroborated by any dividend/corporate-action tracker. These aggregator figures are DISCARDED as unreliable rather than silently blended in; flagged here per the ground-truth-pack instruction to note disagreements rather than pick silently.

CONSOLIDATED vs STANDALONE materially diverge for MOL and this is a genuine feature of the business, not a data error: standalone (parent-only) FY26 net profit is Rs 125.26 Cr (ROE ~7.1-7.4%), while consolidated (group, including loss-making subsidiaries Meghmani Crop Nutrition and Kilburn Chemicals) FY26 net profit is only Rs 28.74 Cr (ROE ~1.86-1.88%). All headline figures in this pack default to CONSOLIDATED (matching screener.in/groww.in convention) with standalone figures included alongside for context.

Price and market cap were cross-checked across 2 independent live sources (screener.in and groww.in); both agree closely on price (Rs 46.40 vs Rs 46.39) and market cap (Rs 1,178 Cr vs Rs 1,171 Cr, ~0.6% spread) — not a material disagreement.

52-week price change % (1-year return) could NOT be resolved to a single confident figure: search-derived snippets from different aggregator families gave -42.18% in one cluster and -49.3%/-49.51% in another, for what appear to be similar (but not verified-identical) reference dates in late June 2026. This is reported as an open range rather than silently resolved — flagged for a follow-up direct historical-price lookup if precision is required.

A live corporate action is in flight: Kilburn Chemicals Limited and Meghmani Crop Nutrition Limited (both wholly-owned subsidiaries) are being amalgamated INTO Meghmani Organics Limited via an NCLT scheme (board-approved 4-Apr-2026, appointed date 1-Jan-2026, shareholder approval ~June 2026, NCLT sanction pending as of the FY26 results date). This will likely collapse much of the standalone/consolidated gap described above once effective — worth re-checking in a future data pull.

No dividend was paid in the trailing 12 months (last actual payout was the FY2023 final dividend of Rs 1.40/share, ex-date 20-Jun-2023); dividend yield is 0.00% per both cross-checked sources. Face value is Re 1 per share.

As of the research date (2026-07-10), Q1 FY27 (Apr-Jun 2026) results had not yet been published; Q4 FY26 (quarter ended 31-Mar-2026, reported 14-May-2026) is correctly the latest reported quarter used throughout this pack.
